export default { id: "mountain-peak", title: "Mountain", knobs: { width: { value: 560, min: 240, max: 900, label: "Width" }, height: { value: 320, min: 160, max: 420, label: "Height" }, distance: { value: 220, min: 0, max: 800, label: "Distance ahead" } }, setup(api, knobs) { const p = api.player(); const baseX = p ? p.x + Number(knobs.distance) : Number(knobs.distance); const w = Number(knobs.width); const h = Number(knobs.height); api.spawn({ type: "mountain", x: baseX, y: 400 - h, w, h, solid: false, gravityScale: 0, color: 0x6f7f96, data: { landmark: true } }); }, dispose(api) { for (const e of api.byType("mountain")) api.despawn(e.id); }, test(t) { t.step(2); const m = t.api.byType("mountain")[0]; t.expect(!!m, "mountain spawned"); t.expect(!!m && m.y + m.h === 400, "mountain is anchored to the ground"); t.expect(!!m && m.h >= 160 && m.solid === false, "mountain is a tall non-solid landmark"); } }
